description: MUST-FAIL: identifier grammar, surrounding spaces. Same clause pair as kat-20 (section 4.1 grammar, section 6.1 consistency, section 4 recomputation): a hex digest padded with spaces is not a 64-character lowercase hex string, and a verifier MUST NOT trim before comparing. Split from the trailing-newline vector on purpose: an implementation may tolerate one whitespace class and not the other, and a combined vector would not say which.

registry_entry.name: cpb-day2-artifact
registry_entry.digest_context: jcs-n; empty exclusion set; 64-char lowercase hex

note: Leading-tab padding (U+0009) fails for the identical reason; kept out of this vector so each whitespace class stays separately attributable.
